Sayo"Madam, you are being caught with full enthusiasm."

さよ「がっつり釣られておりますよ、お嬢さま」

Kanae"Oh, what an unusual texture."
Sayo"Like biting into a peach or a pear. Soft, with some spring to it. Chew properly and it crunches away, and there is a strong fragrance..."

en.html:
Sayo"Well now. Ostrich is supposed to be lean meat, but this one has marbling."
Kanae"What magnificent meat! Kageaki, this fat—what exactly is it...?"
Kageaki"I shall explain after you finish."

香奈枝「なんて素晴らしいお肉！ 　景明さま、この脂肪はいったい……？」
景明「食べ終わってからお教えします」

en.html:
Kanae"KYAAAAAA!!"
Sayo"M-M-Minato sir! The stone flute! Where is the stone flute!?"
Kageaki"We have none."

景明「ありません」

en.html:
Sayo"—Incidentally. Time is supposed to be more precious than gold just now. It is flowing away like wastewater. What arrangement shall we make for this fact?"
Kanae"None can be made, I am afraid."
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"PEHLE ROKNA THA! You should have stopped me BEFORE THIS!"
Kanae"...I did not think you would actually do it."
Sayo"...Somehow, saying the obvious felt like admitting defeat."

You should have stopped me BEFORE THIS!"Kanae"...I did not think you would actually do it."Sayo"...Somehow, saying the obvious felt like admitting defeat."

さよ「――ところで。 　今、黄金よりも貴重な筈の時間が生活排水 よろしく無駄に流れ去っているという事実を いかがいたしましょうや」
香奈枝「どうしようもありませんね」
景明「…………」
景明「こうなる前に止めて下さい！」
香奈枝「……本当にやるとは思わなくて」
さよ「……なんか突っ込んだら負けのような気が いたしまして」
